summary: AI strategies accelerate, yet many remain paralyzed by "silent" data silos. Scaling requires a fusion of leadership, modern tech, and community. Discover how Workday and Huwise transformed 5M+ technical assets into 75 trusted Data Products for both business users and AI agents. Learn how a community-led approach creates "AI-ready" data, enabling teams to scale intuitive access, eliminate inefficiencies, and deliver measurable ROI at speed.
